During sequential cleanup, each early snapshot correctly contained siblings that had not yet reached their cleanup turn. The final cycle-level tagged-survivor scan was empty in all20 cycles, but the frozen implementation still marked cleanup false.

prospective_correction.single_engineering_change: Judge zero tagged survivors only once after the complete registered child cleanup sequence; retain per-child snapshots as diagnostic evidence rather than individual terminal gates.
